newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Nepal awards kero to Vitol, mulls new tenders.
newsitem.headline: Nepal awards kero to Vitol, mulls new tenders.

text.p: State-owned Nepal Oil Corp (NOC) has bought by tender 30,000 tonnes of superior kerosene from Dutch trader Vitol at $199.37 per tonne for July 1-10 delivery, cost-and-freight (c+f) Indian east coast, an NOC official said on Thursday.
This was lower than the cargo Nepal bought in the last tender for May 1-10 delivery, at $204 per tonne, c+f to Mitsubishi Corp.
The official said Nepal will decide next week on a new tender to buy 30,000 tonnes of kerosene for July 21-31 delivery, c-and-f east coast.
Nepal is also considering to issue tenders to buy three high speed diesel cargoes for August 11-20, August 21-31 and September 11-20 deliveries, the official said.
